name: RG Singing AI Recording Tool
scope: All P0/P1/P2 recording and analysis features retained
Reviewed annotation to frame-aligned NPZ dataset builder
Training/validation MSE logging and best checkpoint selection
Expanded alignment validation and dataset pipeline tests
limitations: No acoustic forced alignment; phoneme timestamps must be reviewed or externally aligned
Builder currently assigns vocabulary IDs per item; multi-take training requires a shared vocabulary mapping
Validation split in trainer is file-level; use song/phrase group splits to avoid leakage
Mel predictor and Griffin-Lim renderer are experimental and not production-quality singing synthesis
Feature inversion/filter-bank consistency is not yet calibrated
